question: What is the name and capacity of the stadium with the highest capacity?
schema_context: CREATE TABLE stadium (Stadium_ID int PRIMARY KEY, Location text, Name text, Capacity int, Highest int, Lowest int, Average int);
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY Capacity DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many concerts were held in year 2014?
schema_context: CREATE TABLE concert (concert_ID int PRIMARY KEY, concert_Name text, Theme text, Stadium_ID text, Year text);
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM concert WHERE Year = '2014';

question: List singer names and song titles for all singers who have songs with sales above 1000.
schema_context:
CREATE TABLE singer (Singer_ID int PRIMARY KEY, Name text, Country text, Song_Name text, Song_release_year text, Is_male bool);
CREATE TABLE song (Song_ID int PRIMARY KEY, Title text, Singer_ID int, Sales int);
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, T2.Title FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID WHERE T2.Sales > 1000;

question: Find the average capacity of all stadiums located in France.
schema_context: CREATE TABLE stadium (Stadium_ID int PRIMARY KEY, Location text, Name text, Capacity int);
gold_sql: SELECT avg(Capacity) FROM stadium WHERE Location = 'France';

question: Find all concerts and stadiums joined across complex subqueries.
schema_context:
CREATE TABLE concert (concert_ID int, Stadium_ID int);
CREATE TABLE stadium (Stadium_ID int, Name text);
gold_sql: SELECT T1.concert_ID, T2.Name FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.Stadium_ID = T2.Stadium_ID;
